regime_context: Detector shows a narrow, eligible leadership concentrated in Banks (H + HK) with high durability and breadth, while the entire Tech/Internet complex is deeply ineligible and mean-reverting (China Tech & Internet score -0.677, hurst_tag mean-revert). Rotation breadth is only 3-of-17 eligible themes (frac 0.18, 'narrow'), so this is a defensive, financials-led regime with no confirmed handoff. Gate helps on this market's history, so the absolute-trend discipline is the one validated leg.
emerging_watch: Watching Energy (H-shares): it is the challenger (score 0.89) but currently NOT eligible on the absolute-trend gate. The single observable condition that would retire this watch is Energy turning eligible while simultaneously closing more than half of its 0.493 score-margin gap to the Banks leader. Until then it remains an unconfirmed challenger only.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks lead the eligible set with the highest score, durability_bar 0.69 (above the typical 0.5 threshold), and strong breadth 0.769 — all three legs (rank, durability, trend-width) align. The rotation leader is the only theme with both high durability and non-trivial breadth, making it the most coherent trend in a narrow market. Lean is overweight only as a DIRECTION: the theme remains the acknowledged market leader.
evidence: gate_helps=true, so trend-gate discipline supports staying with the eligible leader
theses.dissent: Cross-sectional rank-IC is ~0 — the top score carries no alpha on its own; and Banks weighting 0.25 in a cash-heavy (0.5) headline suggests the detector is already defensively positioned, so an overweight lean adds little incremental signal.

The lean is an avoid direction: no reason to allocate toward an ineligible, low-durability laggard.
